summary: OBJECT at 0 MUST-FIX and 2 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody, repository pins, the eleven supersession rows, all twenty-eight recording headings, the ten citation pairs and first quoted sites, every leftoverDesign partition, every projected registerRow/file08StatusToken/liveGateOwners value, every named-obligation projection field, the live file-08 standings, D-000 authority, and the no-cell branch reproduce. Six of seven named turn-1 findings are fully landed. CLAUDE-D294-SF1 stands in part: turn 2 widens the rule to the inverted and Cite forms but recomputes only the two inverted sites. The five qualifying purpose sentences contribute six pair-sites, so the widened total is 35 with per-pair counts [4,4,4,2,2,5,4,3,2,5], not 29. The permission-to-g09 purpose sentence is excluded by the rule's historical-marker guard because the same sentence says the predecessor 'cited g09 leftover-join.v2.' The rationale also falsely says D-287 refreshed its cross-citations in passing; distribution-core leftover-join.v9 expressly says it cites no GATE leftover-join and contains no cross-lineage leftover-join citation. Neither defect changes the ten-pair projection result or live standing, but both must be repaired before CONSENT.

shouldFix.bytesContradicting: The old 27-site grammar plus the two inverted sites yields the draft's 29. The newly included Cite form contributes six more qualifying pair-sites in five purpose sentences: component-manifest v9 -> g15 v5; doctor-actor v12 -> g12 v4 and -> g21 v12; packaging v4 -> component-manifest v6; permission v12 -> doctor-actor v11; state-class v4 -> g19 v4. Those statements are present-tense, name the lineage and version, assert current currency, carry no listed historical marker, and do not name the relevant current successor in the same sentence. Permission v12's separate g09 Cite clause is not counted: its same semicolon-joined sentence says permission v9 'cited g09 leftover-join.v2,' which invokes the measurement rule's historical-marker exclusion.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Change the headline total to 35 and the Sites column, in row order, to [4,4,4,2,2,5,4,3,2,5]. The compound doctor-actor Cite sentence asserts currency for both g12 and g21, so both pair-sites count.
